examples.text: Cette agence ne représente que des stars.

meanings.note: une agence artistique = a talent agency

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: aller + infinitive: tu vas l'agacer = you're going to annoy her
ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
to draw a conclusion or move on

examples.trans: Botox every year, and her eyes two years ago.

meanings.note: j'en ai assez = I've had enough, I'm fed up

examples.trans: Andréa is looking for an assistant.

examples.text: Je trouve une assistante qui me plaît.
examples.trans: I find an assistant I like.

examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: Elles sont très proches. C'est difficile de cacher des choses à ses amies.
examples.trans: They're very close. It's hard to hide things from your friends.

meanings.note: cacher quelque chose à quelqu'un = hide something from someone
autre chose = something else, anything else
used for both masculine and feminine

examples.trans: Second, because she is my colleague and my friend.

examples.trans: I am afraid of losing the trust of my colleagues.

examples.text: C'est comme un rêve pour moi.
examples.trans: It's like a dream for me.

examples.text: Faites-moi confiance, Audrey. Beyoncé a fait ça après son concert.
examples.trans: Trust me, Audrey. Beyoncé did that after her concert.

je ne crois pas = I don't think so

examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

meanings.note: for a feminine noun: l'industrie... elle
preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.trans: I want to see my daughter.

examples.text: Je suis très heureuse ici, je ne veux pas gâcher ça.

examples.text: Je suis très heureux pour vous.

examples.trans: This is Marie-Sophie Garnier, head screenwriter on Happy Ever After.

examples.trans: Leave your photos and your CV here.

meanings.note: for masculine nouns, and in impersonal phrases: il y a

examples.trans: Gabriel! I'm at my horse-riding lesson.

object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille

examples.trans: You're a liar and a coward. I know it's because of my age.

examples.trans: Did you put your photo in this envelope?

examples.text: Je l'ai mise dans une enveloppe.

meanings.note: tout le monde = everyone; il y a du monde = it's crowded
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.trans: We're at the Westin. Everyone is here.

meanings.note: everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Elle a peur de rater quelque chose.
Trouve-moi quelque chose de fort! Tu me suis?
examples.trans: Find me something powerful! Do you follow me?

meanings.note: alone, in surprise or when you didn't hear; a bit blunt

examples.text: Et j'ai réparé son chemisier préféré.
examples.trans: And I fixed her favourite blouse.

meanings.en: to repair, to fix, to mend
meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Core French verb meaning 'to repair, to fix'.

examples.text: Tes premières vacances en huit ans!

meanings.note: informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir

meanings.note: dire la vérité = to tell the truth
